ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.ShiftDefinition

Generates the Cross Currency curves for the definitions provided

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.ShiftDefinition.

Syntax

ShiftDefinition(
    *,
    butterfly_shift: ButterflyShift | None = None,
    combined_shifts: list[CombinedShift] | None = None,
    flattening_shift: FlatteningShift | None = None,
    long_end_shift: LongEndShift | None = None,
    parallel_shift: ParallelShift | None = None,
    short_end_shift: ShortEndShift | None = None,
    time_bucket_shifts: list[TimeBucketShift] | None = None,
    twist_shift: TwistShift | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
butterfly_shift ButterflyShift | None No None The definition of attributes for butterfly shift scenario. the start and end curve points are shifted by amount. the curve point at pivot tenor is not shifted.
combined_shifts list[CombinedShift] | None No None The definition of attributes for combined shifts scenario. each element of the combined shifts scenario describes separate shift scenario applied to curve points. if one scenario follows the other, they are added to each other.
flattening_shift FlatteningShift | None No None The definition of attributes for flattening / steepening shift scenario. the start curve point is shifted by [amount / 2], the end curve point is shifted by [-amount / 2].
long_end_shift LongEndShift | None No None The definition of attributes for long end shift scenario. the end curve point is shifted by amount. the start curve point is not shifted. the shift rises from 0 to amount between the start and the end curve point.
parallel_shift ParallelShift | None No None The definition of attributes for parallel shift scenario. each curve point is shifted by amount.
short_end_shift ShortEndShift | None No None The definition of attributes for short end shift scenario. the start curve point is shifted by amount. the end curve point is not shifted. the shift decreases from 0 to amount between the start and the end curve point
time_bucket_shifts list[TimeBucketShift] | None No None The definition of attributes for time bucket shift scenario. each element of timebucketshifts describes the separate parallel shift. this shift applies from starttenor to endtenor.
twist_shift TwistShift | None No None The definition of attributes for twist shift scenario. the start and end curve points are shifted by amount. the curve point at pivot tenor is not shifted.

Properties
